Easing curves along a power of 4.

![The Quart easing curves in a dark grey frame that marks 0 and 1: IN in blue, OUT in light grey, IN_OUT in grey, named under the curves, with one dot per curve that runs along it from the start to the end](/captures/catalog-easing-quarttweenequation.webp)

## Description

Each constant is also in [`TweenEquations`](/reference/animation/tweenequations/), as `QUART_IN`, `QUART_OUT` and `QUART_IN_OUT`.

## Constant and field details

<a id="QuartTweenEquation-constant-IN"></a>

### IN

`QuartTweenEquation IN` 

Starts slowly, with a power of 4.

<a id="QuartTweenEquation-constant-OUT"></a>

### OUT

`QuartTweenEquation OUT` 

Ends slowly, with a power of 4.

<a id="QuartTweenEquation-constant-IN_OUT"></a>

### IN_OUT

`QuartTweenEquation IN_OUT` 

Starts and ends slowly, with a power of 4.
